objective: Review commit 450465c (holyagent setup, doctor, /holyagent:setup, SessionStart setup check) for correctness and regressions before it is pushed.

Intent: HolyAgent installs with `claude plugin marketplace add davidbasilefilho/holyagent`, `claude plugin marketplace add ranxianglei/billion-context`, `claude plugin install holyagent@holyagent` and nothing else; prerequisites Bun on PATH, Node LTS, git, authenticated gh. README keeps its six sections in order (AGENTS.md).

Known Windows baseline: about 107 tests in packages/* fail on untouched main on this machine (symlink EPERM, backslash paths, POSIX modes, bundled hook tests); compare against that rather than treating them as new.
constraints: Read-only: no edits, no version-control writes, nothing under .git/ or .holyagent/.
When the review is done, stop and report findings marked blocking or non-blocking with file:line; launch no other reviewers.
